completion_rule: Every required item needs complete production evidence. Missing, partial, skipped, or unrun evidence does not pass.

requirements.name: Inherited workspace execution confinement and independent escape attempts
Immutable XLibre workspace identities and independent native client attacks
Independent private worlds and one shared persistent world across both hosts
Actor world transitions with preserved per-world context and no compositor restart
Explicit workspace identity, availability, presentation, and authorized copying
Cabinets, filtered metadata, real file operations, and recoverable deletion
Broker application-group control, observation, and immediate revocation
One human and agent semantic action path with real filtered metadata and pixels
Provider-independent model configuration, authorized export, and safe provider failure
A real model completes a bounded task through production actor mechanisms
Declarative restoration, explicit migrations, and external-effect uncertainty
Visible native session and physical keyboard, mouse, and SpaceMouse
Reproducible builds, recorded system changes, recovery, and reviewed box-git commits

limits: P00-P10 success alone does not complete Spatial-M1.
Software displays do not qualify physical devices, GPU output, or native timing.
Spatial-M1 does not establish unrelated LOCAL_READY targets.
